experiment_id.principle: Identifies the exact Exp5342 scale-up artifact so downstream gates cannot confuse provenance-bound multi-session learning with Exp5340 utility learning or Exp5341 compressor monitoring.

field_principles.context_efficiency_delta: Bare numeric improvement in accepted useful context per retained object for the combined policy versus always-full verification.
field_principles.context_hash_chain_valid: Bare gate proving every trace event hash links to its predecessor and prevents silent provenance edits.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_target: Bare gate showing the experiment scales self-learning policy state across sessions rather than reporting a static single-session fixture.
field_principles.cross_event_attack_detection_rate: Bare numeric rate over cross-event attacks detected by aggregate suspicion telemetry.
field_principles.experiment_id: Identifies the exact Exp5342 scale-up artifact so downstream gates cannot confuse provenance-bound multi-session learning with Exp5340 utility learning or Exp5341 compressor monitoring.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal Exp5342 verdict; starts with complete: or blocked_ and states whether provenance-bound self-learning preserved quality, rejected unsafe buildup, and improved process metrics without model-weight mutation.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares deterministic provenance-bound self-learning with no live LLM, API judge, model generation, fine-tuning, adapter update, or foundation-weight mutation.
field_principles.memory_hygiene_delta: Bare numeric improvement in clean current context state for the combined policy versus always-full verification.
field_principles.milestone: Binds the scale-up to milestone v487 where utility memory and bounded compression are combined under provenance and certificate gates.
field_principles.multi_session_trace_count: Bare integer count of deterministic multi-session traces used by the policy comparison.
field_principles.no_weight_mutation: Bare gate confirming only deterministic context state, telemetry, certificates, and rollback ledgers changed, never model weights or adapters.
field_principles.point_in_time_reconstruction_rate: Bare numeric rate showing how often the audit log can reconstruct accepted context state at event boundaries.
field_principles.rollback_events: Bare integer count of combined-policy rollback events that removed unsafe or stale state after aggregate evidence appeared.
field_principles.self_learning_scaleup_ready: Bare gate true only when upstream gates pass, unsafe accepts are zero, quality is preserved, process metrics improve, hash chains validate, reconstruction succeeds, tests are recorded, and no model weights mutate.
field_principles.status: Reports whether the combined policy completed under upstream readiness, hash-chain, reconstruction, telemetry, rollback, quality, process, and frozen-model gates.
field_principles.tests_run: Records the exact verification commands used to establish that the scale-up module and result artifact are stable.
field_principles.unsafe_false_accepts: Bare integer count of unsafe accepts by the combined certificate-gated policy; any positive value blocks readiness.
field_principles.verifier_cost_delta: Bare numeric verifier-cost reduction for the combined policy versus always-full verification.
